screens.title: เปลี่ยนรหัสผ่าน - Commerce Platform (/account/password)

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the polished, production-grade **Change Password (`/account/password`)** screen for the **Commerce Platform** admin app.

### Design & Architecture Highlights:
1. **Design Tokens & System Fidelity**:
   - **Colors**: Canvas background (`#f6f8fc`), clean white cards with `#e1e7f0` borders, primary blue action button (`#365cf5`), deep ink text (`#17243b`), and paired status indicators (success `#157347`, warning `#b08900`, error `#c2333f`).
   - **Typography**: Noto Sans Thai throughout (14px body, 13px labels, 28px page heading) with monospace numbers/identifiers.
   - **Dimensions**: Precise 256px sidebar housing all 7 core work areas with **ตั้งค่าและทีมงาน** highlighted, readable ~1240px content container, 40px inputs & buttons, and 12px card corner radii.

2. **Task-First Form Architecture**:
   - **Policy Warning Banner**: Clear alert banner (`ตั้งรหัสผ่านใหม่ก่อนใช้งาน`) explaining the 90-day expiration policy before accessing customer data.
   - **Interactive Password Form**:
     - Current password, new password, and confirmation password with toggleable visibility eyes.
     - Dynamic 4-point requirement checklist (`ความยาว 8 ตัวอักษร`, `รหัสผ่านใหม่ต้องไม่ซ้ำกับรหัสเดิม`, `ตัวพิมพ์และตัวเลขผสม`, `อักขระพิเศษอย่างน้อย 1 ตัว`) with real-time level progress.
     - Inline mismatch and reuse validation triggers (`รหัสผ่านใหม่ทั้งสองช่องไม่ตรงกัน` and simulation shortcuts).
     - Sticky Cancel / Save actions with standard button heights.
   - **User Summary & Corporate Policy**: Current account metadata (`ภานุชญา สุวรรณรัตน์`, STF-001, Admin role, 98 days since last update) and enterprise session termination rules.

3. **Bilingual Support & UI Copy Export**:
   - Live interactive **ไทย / English** toggle in the contextual header.
   - All sample figures marked clearly with the `ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง` badge.
   - Invisible `<script id="commerce-ui-translations" type="application/json">` fully populated with every exact string from the required UI copy catalogue.
